entities.summary: Rosa Mbuamangongo Malango Dyombe is an Equatoguinean diplomat, former sprinter and former journalist, who serves as United Nations Director, Regional Commissions, New York Office. In this capacity, she works with UN Regional Economic Commissions in Africa, the Americas, Asia and Europe. She was appointed to that position, in June 2021, by António Guterres, the UN Secretary General.
